# CompoundV3Ark
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/CompoundV3Ark.sol)

**Inherits:**
[Ark](../ark.md)

**Title:**
CompoundV3Ark

Ark contract for managing token supply and yield generation for Compound V3.

Implements strategy for supplying tokens, withdrawing tokens, and claiming rewards on Compound V3.


## State Variables
### comet
The Compound V3 Comet contract


```solidity
IComet public comet
```


### cometRewards
The Compound V3 CometRewards contract


```solidity
ICometRewards public cometRewards
```

### totalAssets

Returns the current underlying balance of the Ark

```solidity
function totalAssets() public view override returns (uint256 assets);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The total assets in the Ark, in token precision|


### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

Returns the full balance when withdrawals are enabled on the Comet
market, but returns 0 while comet.isWithdrawPaused() is true (the
Comet pause guardian can pause withdrawals).


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256 withdrawableAssets);
```
